name: Eldad
overview: The Scripture passage in Numbers 11:26-29 introduces Eldad as one of two men upon whom the Spirit of God rested, enabling them to prophesy within the camp of Israel rather than at the tabernacle. Despite Joshua's concern and request to Moses to forbid their prophesying, Moses expresses a desire for all God's people to be prophets and to receive the Spirit. This account highlights God's sovereign distribution of His Spirit and the blessing of prophetic ministry beyond expected boundaries.
